summary: A locally built Workbench debug executable created a native RepoPact Workbench window, but its embedded view displayed a connection refusal at 127.0.0.1. The current Tauri debug configuration points to http://127.0.0.1:1420 and no development server was running. This attempt does not establish bundled-app or installed-app launch acceptance and does not establish a product regression.

commands.summary: Debug executable built from Workbench main 414a4a78091796735a1b97b03fd8c3cf1c105f30.

The UI request timed out. A subsequent window inventory showed the process running and a window titled RepoPact Workbench; captured window state showed the configured development URL returning connection refused.
The native window was observed. Its content showed 127.0.0.1 refused to connect. A separate Windows firewall dialog for fabric_beacon was visible and was not accepted or changed.

environment.authorization: The operator explicitly authorized one local executable launch.
environment.launch_scope: One locally built debug executable only; no installer was installed, no firewall rule was changed, and no release was published.
